method: Read-only CGNS source-plane polygon connectivity. Trace opposite edges of consecutive quads along each wall column; project cell thickness on original local wall normal. Compare by interpolating at 17 fixed x/c locations per surface, 0.1 to 0.9, at six common physical wall distances. Core uses fixed point nearest-cell area diagnostics only.
reason: Near-wall first-cell ratio is approximately 1.4, while cell spacing deeper through most of the prism thickness barely refines. Distance-averaged spacing over finite bands confirms the mismatch; not merely a cell-boundary sampling artifact. A single scalar h does not represent this strongly nonuniform directional refinement adequately for the proposed whole-solution GCI. Existing meshes remain usable for mesh sensitivity, but formal GCI needs a redesigned systematic wall-normal family or separately quantified directional errors.
scope: Pre-run mesh family audit only. No new solver process, queue mutation, mesh edit, or human-readable report. No claim that these meshes are invalid for CFD or that any possible directional verification is impossible.
criterion_source: ITTC 7.5-03-01-01 rev05 (2024), section3.3, pp7-8: systematic relationship and nearly constant local refinement ratio; numerical suitability assessed separately from mesh validity.
